verdict.rationale: Bland documents several ways to test before going live: LLM-judge evals that grade calls, a testbed that re-runs isolated node interactions from test chats or historical calls, browser-based test talking, and development/staging environments so drafts don't affect live calls. Missing for 10: no explicit automated simulated-caller or persona-driven conversation simulation, no clear documentation that evals run on pre-production test conversations rather than completed calls, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
